prescriptions.title: Phase 56
prescriptions.directive: Focus core systems development on **Phase 56: Bounded World Chronicle, Witness Memory & Rumor Network**: Bounded circular buffer of the last 50 significant historical events in `WorldState.chronicle`. NPCs in line-of-sight or acoustic range log witnessed incidents into `witnessedEvents`, diffusing rumors across shift changes with faction-slanted blame attribution in dynamic dialogue barks. resolving unwiredCommands and telemetry anomalies.
